findings.what: Client maxLength counts UTF-16 code units while server counts code points (contact-validation.ts:16-18); astral-character input can be blocked client-side although server-valid
key={JSON.stringify(state)} remounts the form after each submit, losing keyboard focus; no focus management to first invalid field
DB path defaults to cwd-relative data/contact.sqlite using experimental node:sqlite; breaks on read-only/serverless hosts, undocumented
store.save errors are not caught; a DB failure throws out of the server action instead of showing an inline form error
